description: This header file defines the interface and data structures for the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE) in the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes function declarations related to resource management (open, close, read, write, seek, get length) conditioned on the macro '_BREE_SPO_USE_SRMO'.

methods.name: BreeSpoCookedResOpen
methods.description: Opens a resource file given its filename, with specified flags and mode.

methods.name: BreeSpoCookedResClose
methods.description: Closes an opened resource file handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoCookedResRead
methods.description: Reads data from a resource file into a buffer.

methods.name: BreeSpoGetCookedResLength
methods.description: Returns the length of an opened resource file.

methods.name: BreeSpoCookedResSeek
methods.description: Repositions the read/write offset within an open resource file.

methods.name: BreeSpoCookedResWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a resource file from a buffer.
